records.source: gRNA identifiers treated as non-targeting controls. Their coefficients define the effect-size cutoff drawn on the volcano plot: abs(median(control coefficients)) + threshold_multiplier × spread, where threshold_method selects the spread estimator. A wider control distribution raises the cutoff. None disables the effect-size cutoff. Default ['000000'] -- the non-cutting control GENE, which spaCR resolves to every one of its guides in the library you loaded, rather than a hand-typed list that goes stale. A guide id works too, with or without the organism prefix.
records.translation: 作为非靶向对照处理的 gRNA 标识符。其系数定义火山图上绘制的效应量阈值：abs(median(control coefficients)) + threshold_multiplier × spread，其中 threshold_method 选择离散度估计方法。对照系数分布越宽，阈值越高。None 会禁用效应量阈值。默认值为 ['000000']——这是非切割对照 GENE；spaCR 会根据已加载的文库将它解析为该基因的所有向导，而不是使用容易过时的手工列表。也可以提供单个向导 ID；带或不带物种前缀的两种写法都可用。

records.source: gRNA or gene identifiers known not to occur in cells, such as primer or plasmid carry-over. These sequences are removed before guide fractions are calculated, and retained guides are renormalized. This differs from background subtraction, which corrects spurious reads assigned to a real guide. A gene identifier matches all of its guides. Default None.
records.translation: 已知不存在于细胞中的 gRNA 或基因标识符，例如引物或质粒残留。这些序列会在计算向导片段占比之前被移除，保留下来的向导会重新归一化。这与背景扣除不同：背景扣除校正的是错误分配给某个真实向导的读数。基因标识符会匹配该基因的所有向导。默认值为 None。
